an10.11:1.1: Pañcaṅgasamannāgato bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ senāsanaṃ sevamāno bhajamāno na cirass' eva āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya.
an10.11:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgato hoti? 2.
an10.11:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddho hoti saddahati Tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
an10.11:2.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti,
an10.11:2.4: appābādho hoti appātaṅko samavepākiniyā gahaṇiyā samannāgato nātisītāya nāccuṇhāya majjhimāya padhānakkhamāya,
an10.11:2.5: asaṭho hoti amāyāvī yathābhūtaṃ attānaṃ āvikattā Satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu,
an10.11:2.6: āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu,
an10.11:2.7: paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an10.11:2.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgato hoti.
an10.11:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave senāsanaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ hoti? 3.
an10.11:3.2: Idha bhikkhave senāsanaṃ nātidūraṃ hoti nāccāsannaṃ gamanāgamanasampannaṃ,
an10.11:3.5: tasmiṃ kho pana senāsane viharantassa appakasiren' eva uppajjanti cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārā,
an10.11:3.6: tasmiṃ kho pana senāsane therā bhikkhū viharanti bahussutā āgatāgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā,
an10.11:3.7: te kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā paripucchati paripañhati
an10.11:3.8: ‘idaṃ bhante kathaṃ, imassa ko attho' ti?
an10.11:3.9: Tassa te āyasmanto avivaṭañ c' eva vivaranti anuttānikatañ ca uttānikaronte anekavihitesu ca kaṅkhāṭṭhāniyesu dhammesu kaṅkhaṃ paṭivinodenti.
an10.11:3.10: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave senāsanaṃ pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ hoti.
an10.11:3.11: Pañcaṅgasamannāgato kho bhikkhave bhikkhu pañcaṅgasamannāgataṃ senāsanaṃ sevamāno bhajamāno na cirass' eva āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyā
